svg.title: How bim-ai-architect works
svg.desc: You describe a BIM AI app in plain words (here: a weekly check that Revit element materials match the spec and client feedback); the skill splits it into sub-tasks, gives each to code, AI or a person, and returns an Architecture Brief with the task split, flow, contracts, send gate and tests.

g.text: A weekly check for our Revit models:
MEP) match the spec and the client's
feedback? Flag missing or wrong ones
and report to each discipline team.

svg.text: It asks only what it cannot work out:
Seven questions decide: does it write? one correct

g.text: Every choice comes with a reason.
Next step 1 is small enough for tomorrow.

svg.text: Code compares and reports · AI reads the spec and feedback · people approve
